name: Wuxi Chipown Micro-electronics limited
summary: Wuxi Chipown Micro-electronics limited engages in the research, development, and sale of semiconductor products in China. The company offers HV products, including AC-DC, PFC and X capacitor discharge; LV products, such as DC-DC, car charger, battery charger, LED backlight, high power white LED, OVP and current limiter, reset and detect, and LDO products; and drivers that include high and low side gate, 3-phase gate, isolated gate, brushed motor, stepper motor, and low side gate driver IC. It also provides charger protocol IC; power devices comprising IGBT, SJ, SiC, and planar MOSFET, and GaN FET; and power module products, which includes IPM and wireless charger micro IPM.
